quotes.text: That string was new and never exposed in Pontoon. So there are no translations to migrate anyway.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Check whether the old string ever reached translators before writing a Fluent migration script. In the IRC follow-up, irc.properties had already been removed and the SASL string was new and never exposed in Pontoon. Review requested removing the Python migration, which was accepted. This exception is limited to a string with no existing translations. Established translated strings still require preserving translations through the appropriate migration.
title: A new untranslated Fluent string does not need a translation migration
